title: Abelian networks I. Foundations and examples
notes: Introduces abelian networks, least action, and asynchronous computation on graphs.

title: Abelian networks II. Halting on all inputs
notes: Characterizes halting using the production matrix spectrum.

title: Abelian networks III. The critical group
notes: Generalizes the sandpile critical group and gives a recurrent-state action useful for invariant extraction.

title: On the arithmetic Kakeya conjecture of Katz and Tao
notes: Gives equivalent formulations, finite-field variant, and lower bounds for arithmetic Kakeya.
